description: Land Title Settlement Department - Padawgama, Lunugamwehera D/S Division, Hambanthota District Cad. Map No. 830041 and other land settlements
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration and determinations for specific land parcels in Hambantota District. It involves the declaration of title determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement under the Registration of Title Act, including detailed schedules of land parcels, their extent, ownership status, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its focus on land matters, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related administrative matters.
